```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_2_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_2")
figure_path <- file.path(study_2_path, "figures")

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#analytic sample
dem_solo_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    setup == "SOLO",
    !excluded,
    !participant.code %in% c("l6gxo7po", "n0ndmyka")
  ) # Two participants excluded due to technical errors

solo_ids <- dem_solo_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

solo_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "SOLO") %>%
  semi_join(solo_ids, by = "id")
```

```{r}
# derive performance and sound variables
solo_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    success = as.integer(success),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm"))) %>%
  filter(!(any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1))

```

```{r}
participant_performance <- solo_rounds %>%
  group_by(id, participant.code, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matrices_seen = n(),
    n_matrices_completed = sum(completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_matrices_correct = sum(success, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_secs = mean(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
performance_variables <- c(
  "n_matrices_seen",
  "n_matrices_completed",
  "n_matrices_correct",
  "mean_round_duration_secs")

performance_diagnostics_long <- participant_performance %>%
  select(
    participant.code,
    gender,
    all_of(performance_variables)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(performance_variables),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(
      outcome,
      levels = performance_variables,
      labels = c(
        "Matrices seen",
        "Matrices answered",
        "Matrices correct",
        "Mean round duration")))

p_study2_performance_boxplots <-
  ggplot(
    performance_diagnostics_long,
    aes(x = gender, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.55) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 1.7) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ outcome,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Gender",
    y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s2_welch_assumption_boxplots.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_study2_performance_boxplots,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300)

p_study2_performance_qq <-
  ggplot(
    performance_diagnostics_long,
    aes(sample = value)) +
  stat_qq(
    alpha = 0.70,
    size = 1.6) +
  stat_qq_line(
    linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(
    gender ~ outcome,
    scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Observed quantiles") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s2_welch_assumption_qqplots.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_study2_performance_qq,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Shapiro-Wilk tests by outcome and gender
shapiro_results <- performance_diagnostics_long %>%
  group_by(outcome, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    W = unname(shapiro.test(value)$statistic),
    p = shapiro.test(value)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop")

shapiro_results
```


```{r}
# Primary Welch t-tests
t.test(n_matrices_seen ~ gender, data = participant_performance)
t.test(n_matrices_completed ~ gender, data = participant_performance)
t.test(n_matrices_correct ~ gender, data = participant_performance)
t.test(mean_round_duration_secs ~ gender, data = participant_performance)
```
